author: Jerry Butler
text: I am about 1 month in on the Libre 3+ system.  It took me a few sensors to get it placed where I could grt accurate readings.  I ended up much higher up on the back of the atmosphere where I had enough fat tissue to prevent the false lows.  The diabetes nurse educators at Abbott were really helpful working through this with me.  You can reach them at 833-855-4273.  This is a different group then the regular call center folks.  Hope you get this worked out.  I know that its frustrating.
